protocol_note: New economic hypothesis, not a campaign of the closed trend_sma50 family. Candidates are evaluated through the existing registered economic_walk_forward_v1 protocol; the decision stream is emitted by the real native Rust strategy (mqk backtest native-signals); no trading rule is re-implemented in Python. Hypothesis != trial != attempt != evaluation slice: one hypothesis, one trial per fixed symbol, retries are new attempts of the same trial.

hypothesis.name: Long/flat dual moving-average trend regime on a fixed five-asset-class ETF list
hypothesis.economic_rationale: A broad liquid asset whose 50-day simple moving average is above its 200-day simple moving average is in a confirmed medium/long-term uptrend; trend persistence should make forward returns in that regime large enough to justify a long position after conservative execution costs. When the 50-day average is not above the 200-day average the target is flat. Comparing two averages instead of price against one average is a regime rule that changes state far less often than the closed price-versus-SMA50 rule.
primary_references: Brock, Lakonishok & LeBaron (1992), 'Simple Technical Trading Rules and the Stochastic Properties of Stock Returns', Journal of Finance 47(5):1731-1764
Faber (2007), 'A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation', Journal of Wealth Management 9(4):69-79
Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012), 'Time Series Momentum', Journal of Financial Economics 104(2):228-250
hypothesis.distinct_from_closed_family: trend_sma50 compared the last close with its 50-day mean; this family compares the 50-day mean with the 200-day mean. It is a different rule, not a parameter retry. trend_sma50 is closed and unmodified.
hypothesis.falsification_condition: A symbol's candidate is REJECTED if it fails any gate listed under rejection_gates. The campaign is rejected as a whole if no candidate clears every gate. No other fast/slow pair, band, filter or confirmation rule is evaluated in this campaign.

native_engine.rule: fast_sma = integer mean of the latest 50 completed closes; slow_sma = integer mean of the latest 200 completed closes; target = +1 share if fast_sma > slow_sma, else 0. Equality is flat. Fewer than 200 completed bars, any incomplete bar in the 200-bar window, or any non-positive close is flat. Never short.
native_engine.parameter_rationale: 50 and 200 are the canonical pair of the technical-trading and trend-following literature cited above; fixed here, never tuned, and no other pair is evaluated.

universe.selection_rule: The five asset-class proxies of Faber (2007)'s GTAA list that exist as enabled ETFs in config/instruments/equities.json: US equities, foreign developed equities, 10-year Treasuries, US real estate, commodities. DBC/GSCI is not in the registry; GLD is the registry's commodity proxy.
universe.survivorship_note: A fixed list of long-lived, still-listed ETFs is not point-in-time clean. Each symbol is its own registered trial and the judge deflates over all five, so selection among them is accounted for; residual survivorship of the list itself is a stated limitation.
universe.population_note: Same fixed list as the closed trend_sma50 campaigns. Fifteen trial attempts were already recorded for that other hypothesis family (campaigns 01-03); they are disclosed, are not part of this campaign's judge population (a different hypothesis and experiment), and are not hidden.

experiment.population_policy: The judge's population is every trial registered under real_experiment_id in this campaign's own registry (scope = experiment_id, hypothesis_id unset); losing and failed trials are never excluded by hand.

fallback_if_corporate_action_gate_refuse.note: Boundary already established as corporate-action-safe by prior campaigns. Used only if the fail-closed gate refuses the primary window; declared now, before any result.

reuse_verified_data_from.rule: byte-identical reuse after verifying the provenance manifest artifact_sha256 and row_count against the CSV; no new provider call

partition.holdout_rule: last 6 calendar months of the dataset, reserved_not_evaluated, never consumed by this campaign
partition.warmup_note: The Rust emitter receives bars from 2016-01-04, so the first 200 completed closes exist in 2016-10; signals before that are flat by construction. The partition is carried over unchanged, so roughly the first seven months of fold 1 are structurally flat.

native_backtest.initial_cash_rule: USD 1,000 for every symbol, fixed now; one share of every listed symbol costs less than this over the whole window
native_backtest.bars: the same provenance-bound research bars converted deterministically, truncated at the holdout start

robustness.source_note: Reuses the finite values the Wave06 campaign already froze before its results; the notional cap is half the single-symbol long-only natural position (equity_usd x max_gross_exposure = 100,000).

scanner_review.policy: mqk_backtest::StrategyScanReviewPolicy::default (min_bars 252, min_trades 5, min_return_pct 0, min_alpha_pct 0, max_drawdown_pct 25, min_profit_factor 1.05) -- unchanged
scanner_review.data: the same discovery-only converted bars (truncated at the holdout start), one registry/bars root per campaign run

promotion_policy.note: No canonical production threshold values exist in the deployed configuration. These are fixed now, before any result, and are supplied to the daemon only for the promotion transition.

rejection_gates: economic evaluation fails or is insolvent
judge not evaluable (DSR/PBO) or DSR below promotion_policy minimum or PBO above maximum
any required robustness scenario fails or is not evaluable (canonical P9 gauntlet, genuine shuffled placebo, P7A/P7B stress, DSR/PBO block-count sensitivity)
any promotion_policy threshold fails in canonical evaluate_promotion

stopping_rule.if_no_candidate_clears_every_gate: record REJECTED and stop; any other fast/slow pair, hysteresis or confirmation filter needs a new explicit operator decision
stopping_rule.infrastructure_failure: retry the same attempt/trial identity under the existing contract; an economic failure is finalized failed and never retried

attempt_identity_rules: A retry after an infrastructure failure is a new attempt of the SAME trial_id. trial_id derives from strategy_id, symbol, native semantic fingerprint, bars provenance, partition policy and economic protocol only.
forbidden_after_predeclaration: changing the symbol list, either lookback, partition, costs, sizing or thresholds after seeing any result
defining identity from a result value
promoting any candidate by hand or outside the production transition route
adding any parameter, band, filter or confirmation rule

execution_fidelity.metric: fraction of evaluated bars on which the simulated discrete share position (held before that bar's order) agrees, long vs flat, with the executed desired weight; positions only, never P&L
execution_fidelity.enforced_by: mqk_research.ml.native_signal_registry_integration.NATIVE_EXECUTION_FIDELITY_FLOOR; an attempt below the floor is finalized failed and kept

sizing_note: Carried forward from campaign 03 (equity_usd 100000, max_position_notional_usd 50000, stress cap 25000 = half of baseline so P7B stays strictly tighter). Chosen because campaign 03 showed it removes the fill-time allocation-cap collision (position agreement 1.0), not because of any profitability.

turnover_measurement.rule: measured and reported; no turnover threshold is introduced. Comparison with trend_sma50 happens only after the campaign completes and never changes it.

backtest_history_note: The backtest engine window is max(config bar_history_len, the strategy's required_history_bars()), so a 200-bar rule is evaluated on 200 bars in Backtest, the emitter, the scanner and the stress/robustness reruns.
